facts.business: Starlog Enterprises Limited provides logistics services including port operations, cargo handling, and related infrastructure services.

auditor.name: M/s Bhattacharya Das & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: 1. Investment in South West Port Limited shown at Rs. 12.01 Crore (26% equity) vs SWPL financials showing 10% shareholding; differential 16% transferred to entities with credit balances. Company continues to show original cost and shares pending SWPL approvals. 2. Lender of subsidiary obtained Recovery Certificate from DRT Mumbai for Rs. 6,627.20 lakhs based on Shortfall Undertaking; under challenge at DRAT Mumbai. 3. Preferential allotment of 30,00,000 equity shares at Rs. 50/share raising Rs. 1,500 lakhs in Q1 FY2025-26.

key_risks: Discrepancy in shareholding of South West Port Limited investment
Recovery Certificate of Rs. 6,627.20 lakhs against subsidiary lender under legal challenge
Continued losses and negative cash profits
High dependency on major customers for revenue
